div.div: مَدَاكٌ i. q. صَلَآءَةٌ, (K,) i. e., (TA,) A stone upon which perfume is bruised, brayed, or pounded; (S, TA;) as also ↓ دُوكٌ (TA) and ↓ مِدْوَكٌ : (K:) or this last signifies a stone with which perfume is bruised, brayed, or pounded: (S, TA:) F's making this word and the first to signify the same requires consideration. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
